findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sentiers_randonnee · Private data: historique_meteo · Public sink: electricite, velos_libre_service · Destructive: coupures_eau.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sentiers_randonnee · Private data: historique_meteo · Public sink: electricite, velos_libre_service · Destructive: coupures_eau

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
